name: ComfyUI-VFX-Suite
description: Autonomous VFX Matchmoving, 3D Layout & Generative Set Extension Toolkit for ComfyUI and MCP Agents.

tools.name: vfx_track_camera
tools.description: Performs GLOMAP global SfM tracking with YOLOv8 dynamic masking and Z=0 ground alignment on video footage.

video_path.description: Absolute path to input footage or image sequence.

mask_actors.description: Automatically detect and mask actors and props.

align_ground.description: RANSAC plane fit floor to Z=0.

tools.name: vfx_update_layout_scene
tools.description: Updates 3D proxy primitives, meshes, or keyframe animations in the 3D Layout Editor node.

layout_json.description: JSON serialized list of objects with position, rotation, scale, and keyframes.

tools.name: vfx_render_clay_pass
tools.description: Bakes 3D layout into a Clay playblast image sequence for LTX Layout-To-Render diffusion.

tools.name: vfx_composite_shot
tools.description: Composites generative background with foreground actors using edge feathering, Reinhard harmonization, and light wrapping.
